subject.title: fix(agents): preserve runtime tool inheritance tokens

question: Should maintainers sponsor a conflict-resolution pass that preserves filtered MCP/LSP runtime selector inheritance for spawned subagents?
rationale: The code path controls inherited child-session tool authorization, and current `main` has overlapping policy changes; automation cannot safely decide the final security-boundary merge shape without owner intent.

options.title: Refresh And Review Policy Parity
options.body: Resolve conflicts while preserving current `main` policy surfaces, then have an agent/gateway owner confirm preserved selectors still pass the same effective policy intersection as materialized tools.

options.title: Replace At The Runtime Boundary
options.body: Pause this branch and ask an owner to implement a replacement closer to bundle runtime materialization if selector preservation in inherited state is not the desired contract.

options.title: Defer The Fix
options.body: Keep the canonical bug open and defer this PR if maintainers are not ready to own the child-session authorization behavior.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Review Policy Parity
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts while preserving current `main` policy surfaces, then have an agent/gateway owner confirm preserved selectors still pass the same effective policy intersection as materialized tools.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the delegated-session inherited tool restriction propagation path that this PR changes.
